## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### Through an API

api (Deep Infra) · $1.09/M blended · $0.45 in / $3 out per 1M tokens · [deepinfra.com](https://deepinfra.com/models)

<sub>[price source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/providers/deepinfra/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B.toml): Standard base token rate from models.dev. Provider-specific tiers, long-context surcharges, caching and promotions may differ. · [context source](https://github.com/anomalyco/models.dev/blob/a668908cfe7073faa0363699486fc41a3ff52412/models/alibaba/qwen3.5-397b-a17b.toml)</sub>

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.5 397B-A17B (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~238.7 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

Other versions: ud-iq2_xxs (~119.6 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF:UD-IQ2_XXS` · ud-iq1_m (~60.05 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF:UD-IQ1_M`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Qwen3.5 397B-A17B (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~238.7 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF/tree/main))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF@UD-Q4_K_XL -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: ud-iq2_xxs (~119.6 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF@UD-IQ2_XXS -y` · ud-iq1_m (~60.05 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-GGUF@UD-IQ1_M -y` · 4bit (~223.9 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-4bit -y` · 8bit (~422 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-8bit -y`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Qwen3.5 397B-A17B (4bit, needs ~223.9 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/lmstudio-community](https://huggingface.co/lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-4bit/tree/76a66de5151f25687d96c50254198f1959e25ddd))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~422 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model lmstudio-community/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MLX-8bit`

Official weights and documentation: [huggingface.co/Qwen](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B)
